brand_notes: Focal On Wall 300 series: 301 (2x4", 87 dB claimed, ~$1,099 each) and 302 (4x4", 91 dB claimed, $1,749 each). Slim flax-driver on-walls, also stand-mountable via $499/pair stands. 302 measured 88.0 dB in-room and ~4.9 ohm min (audioholics-focal-on-wall-302). Retail stock of 302 thin (sold out at Audio Advice/Upscale). No wall-voicing claim from Focal.
takeaways: Only independent data is Audioholics in-room 1 m sensitivity (88.0 dB vs 91 dB claimed) and impedance (min ~4.9 ohm, graph-read) - no spinorama
In-room response is not usable for LW deviation or f3; bass reads usable to ~50 Hz in-room
Both critic sources recommend it but say a subwoofer is needed below ~50 Hz
Price per speaker is $1,749, so ~$3,498 per pair
conflicts: Sensitivity 91 dB claimed vs 88.0 dB measured in-room
Min impedance 5 ohm (Focal) vs 3.5 ohm (Audioholics spec box) vs ~4.9 ohm graph-read
